item.title: Farming a House
item.description:
Buying a house is expensive, so the plan is simple:

farm gold, avoid wasting it, and keep pushing toward the target.

The goal

Write about the house you’re working toward, how much it costs, and how you’re tracking progress.

The farming setup

Document what you’re farming, why you chose it, and how much gold you’re making.

Progress

Keep this section updated as the project moves along.
